question: What cycle life (number of cycles to 80% capacity) does the review report for the oxyfluoride Li2Mn2/3Nb1/3O2F?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE text ILIKE '%Nb%' OR text ILIKE '%oxyfluoride%' OR text ILIKE '%80%capacity%' OR text ILIKE '%retention%' ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, page, kind, text FROM atoms WHERE (text ILIKE '%Li2Mn%' OR text ILIKE '%DRX%' OR text ILIKE '%cycle life%' OR text ILIKE '%cycles%') ORDER BY page
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE (page=9 AND line_no>=100) OR (page=10 AND line_no<=8) OR (page=11 AND line_no<=12) ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, figure_id, statement, printed_text, value, unit FROM figure_facts WHERE figure_id IN ('p11.F9','p10.F8')
SELECT id, text FROM atoms WHERE page=11 AND (kind='ocr' OR id LIKE 'p11.F9%') ORDER BY id
SELECT id, page, text FROM atoms WHERE text ILIKE '%80%' OR text ILIKE '%80 %' OR text ILIKE '%fade%' OR text ILIKE '%retention%' OR text ILIKE '%Mn2/3%' OR text ILIKE '%Mn 2/3%' ORDER BY page

request.state: One such example includes the DRX oxyfluoride Li2Mn2/3Nb1/3O2F which relies on the Mn^2 +/Mn^4 + redox center, resulting in specific energies up to [[1000 Wh kg^− 1]].^[36] Other tech-nical challenges for DRX cathodes include: i) identifying new synthesis strategies which effectively incorporate F^− into the anion sublattice while mitigating formation of LiF and other impurities,^[43] ii) the inherently low electronic conductivity of the active material which requires excessive carbon additions in composite cathodes (e.g., ≈20 wt% compared to ≈3–5 wt% in commercial LIB cathodes), iii) sloping voltage profiles resulting from the extent of TM cation disorder,^[44] and iv) unstable cathode–electrolyte interfaces at high degrees of delithiation 2103050 (10 of 16) which require development of new electrolyte formulations.

c_of.instructions: Is [[1000 Wh kg^− 1]] a value of “Li2Mn2/3Nb1/3O2F”?

criteria.true: the passage gives [[1000 Wh kg^− 1]] for “Li2Mn2/3Nb1/3O2F”, or for something “Li2Mn2/3Nb1/3O2F” has, makes or contains
criteria.false: [[1000 Wh kg^− 1]] is given for something else, or the passage does not connect it to “Li2Mn2/3Nb1/3O2F”
